//: Example .explicitrc.json. Drop this file at the root of the project you want ExplicitJS to analyze (it walks up from the analyzed path looking for it). Every key is optional; the value shown is the default used when the key is omitted. Command-line flags always override these values, and include-extra is merged with its --include-extra counterpart on the CLI. The default checks are always on - they cannot be disabled or suppressed; run 'explicitjs list-checks' for the full catalog.
//include-extra: Opt into stricter checks. Defaults to []. Valid values:

optional_param - flag arg?: T in function implementations; prefer the
